# Course Map

95 Topics (72 Foundation, 9 Follow, 8 Judge, 6 Analyse), in default-path order. 58 written so far; the rest are Coming.
A Case marked **to verify** has facts that must be checked against a source before its Topic is written.

## Foundation

### 1. Percent, percentage points and basis points

- ID: `num-percent-bps` · Written
- Needs first: nothing
- Case: **The Fed raises its target rate by 25 basis points** (as of 1994-02-03)
  - Outcome: The 25 bp rise in the overnight rate triggered an immediate 40 bp rise in the 30-year rate; by early May, 75 bp of hikes and 140 bp on long bonds. The funds rate averaged 3.05% in Jan 1994 and 5.45% in Dec 1994.
  - Sources: https://fortune.com/article/the-great-bond-massacre-fortune-1994 https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=GS2,GS10,TB3MS,FEDFUNDS&cosd=1993-12-01&coed=1995-01-01 https://www.federalreserve.gov/econresdata/notes/feds-notes/2015/effects-of-fomc-communications-before-policy-tightening-in-1994-and-2004-20150924.html

### 2. Growth, compounding and logs

- ID: `num-compounding` · Written
- Needs first: Percent, percentage points and basis points
- Case: **The Sensex from base 100 (1979) to 1992** (as of 1992-03-31)
  - Outcome: Base 100 on 1 Apr 1979; 1,001 on 25 Jul 1990; 4,091 on 30 Mar 1992; 4,467 in Apr 1992, about 34% a year compound (own arithmetic). Then 1,980 by Apr 1993.
  - Note: Secondary sources; fetch the BSE history before writing.
  - Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BSE_SENSEX https://www.rediff.com/business/special/spec1/20071009.htm?print=true https://livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/bears-vs-bulls-harshad-mehta-scam-to-covid-19-top-7-biggest-stock-market-crashes-in-indias-financial-market-history-11740843716063.html

### 3. Probability and expected value

- ID: `num-probability` · Written
- Needs first: Percent, percentage points and basis points
- Case: **Long-Term Capital Management, before the loss** (as of 1998-08-01)
  - Outcome: About $30 of debt per $1 of capital at end-1997; lost half its capital by end Aug 1998; 14 firms put in $3.6bn for control on 23 Sep 1998. Teach leverage and loss, not the risk-model inputs (unverified).
  - Sources: https://www.federalreservehistory.org/essays/ltcm-near-failure https://www.federalreserve.gov/boarddocs/testimony/1998/19981001.htm https://www.cftc.gov/sites/default/files/tm/tmhedgefundreport.htm

### 4. Time value and present value

- ID: `present-value` · Written
- Needs first: Growth, compounding and logs
- Case: **The $1.537 billion Mega Millions jackpot** (as of 2018-10-24)
  - Outcome: The winner took the $877,784,124 cash option on 4 Mar 2019, roughly the present value of the 30-payment annuity. Written Topic.
  - Sources: https://www.megamillions.com/ https://home.treasury.gov/resource-center/data-chart-center/interest-rates/TextView?type=daily_treasury_yield_curve
- Case: **Webvan's first-day value** (as of 1999-11-05)
  - Outcome: IPO at $15 raised $375m; first-day close $24.875, market value $7.9bn (not $11bn). Chapter 11 filed 9 Jul 2001; shares half a cent on 10 Jul 2001.
  - Sources: https://www.nytimes.com/1999/11/06/business/webvan-stock-price-closes-65-above-initial-offering.html https://latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2001-jul-10-mn-20432-story.html https://www.nytimes.com/2001/07/09/technology/online-grocer-webvan-to-file-for-chapter-11.html

### 24. Reading empirical claims: causation, data and spreadsheet errors

- ID: `num-econometrics` · Written
- Needs first: Statistics: mean, variance, correlation, regression, Fiscal policy and government debt
- Case: **Reinhart and Rogoff's 90% debt threshold** (as of 2010-05-01)
  - Outcome: Published 2010; in Apr 2013 Herndon, Ash and Pollin found an omitted-rows spreadsheet error, selective exclusions and odd weighting; growth above 90% debt was about 2.2%, not -0.1%. Reinhart and Rogoff admitted the slip.
